purpose: Teach: 車種/日本円/丸の内/新橋/読み物/スチール/ストリーム/ポータブル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、企業の社用車の車種比較研究を続けろ
lines.en: Ren — keep working on that corporate vehicle comparison research.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Brief pause after the name. Tone is instructional but not harsh. Assumes competence. The kind of boss who delegates without micro-managing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。為替市場の日本円の変動を毎日記録します
lines.en: Yes. I'll record the yen's daily movements in the foreign exchange market.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Slight formality in the register. Speaks a touch carefully — showing he's taking the instruction seriously and thinking through implementation. No hesitation, just quiet commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、丸の内ビジネス街の経済論文を読め
lines.en: Ren — read the economic papers on Marunouchi's business district.
lines.style: Clear, task-focused. Same measured authority as before. Slightly longer pause on the name this time, inviting his attention. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新橋の歴史的商業地区の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through the papers on Shinbashi's historical commercial district.
lines.style: Agreeable, attentive. The slightest lift at the end showing he's already thinking about where to find those papers. Still formal, still earnest, but a hair more grounded now.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、社員向け読み物を研究室で輪読しろ
lines.en: Ren — do a group reading session of the staff materials in the lab.
lines.style: Directive without theatricality. Spoken as though this is the natural next step. Brief, confident. The tone of someone who knows what their team needs.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。建材のスチール強度試験を見学します
lines.en: Yes. I'll observe the steel strength testing on the construction materials.
lines.style: Polite agreement with underlying uncertainty. A beat of quiet hesitation — he's processing the assignment, maybe wondering if he heard it right. Respectful but slightly careful in his phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データストリームの解析手法を深く学べ
lines.en: Ren — study the data stream analysis methods in depth.
lines.style: Weight on 'depth'. Measured, deliberate. The instruction carries slightly more emphasis than the previous ones. Still composed, but this one matters. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。フィールド調査用のポータブル機材を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare the portable field equipment for the survey work.
lines.style: Final agreement with quiet resolution. Spoken with a sense of conclusion — he's absorbed the assignment and moved into action-planning mode. Slight exhale of focus at the end.
